title: Sonship in Christ
definition: Sonship in Christ is the believer's new standing as a child and heir of God through union with Jesus.
summary: Sonship in Christ is the believer's adopted identity as a child of God through union with the Son.
christFocus: Jesus Christ is the eternal Son who brings redeemed people into the Father's family.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Sonship in Christ means believers are brought into the family of God through union with the Son. Scripture teaches that salvation gives more than pardon; it gives a new family standing before the Father.

This sonship is received by grace, not earned by spiritual maturity. Believers are adopted and loved because they belong to Christ.

Jesus is the eternal Son who brings redeemed people into His Father's house. In Him, former strangers become children and heirs.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Many believers live like tolerated servants instead of welcomed children. Sonship in Christ corrects fear-based religion and gives dignity to those who feel unwanted, disqualified, or alone.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Pray to God as Father through Christ. Reject the lie that you must earn a seat in God's family, and treat other believers as brothers and sisters purchased by the same Savior.
